# 3RC-D0 settings search (S11 A)

Generated by `make tune-3rcd0`; decisions 1.49–1.50.

The 23 standard runs are a previously inspected regression suite. They informed earlier diagnostics and the low-SoC boundary choice. They share segments with the 40 Mix runs, and the Mix folds also share segments with each other. All runs come from one cell in one campaign.

## Method

40 Mix runs only; per-run mean of experiment-2 and experiment-4 RMSE, then mean within each temperature and equal mean across all six temperatures. p0_soc_std remains 0.2. The unchanged 3RC-D0 tables and legacy Jacobians are used throughout.

864 grid points, then 81 points at factors 1/3, 1 and 3 around the grid winner, rounded to three significant digits. Evaluation order has q_soc slowest and p0_v_std fastest; ties retain that order. Near ties and the chosen objective are checked in Python. The offline C evaluator passes per-row absolute tolerance 1e-8 for SoC and voltage at incumbent and extreme settings on six temperatures before search, and on all 40 Mix runs at each checked winner.

Search wall time (completed grid/refinement work): 180.5 s. Reference checks are excluded. A resumed search sums active search time.

## Selected candidate

Settings: `{'q_soc': 3.33e-09, 'q_v': 3.33e-08, 'r': 0.00333, 'p0_v_std': 0.005}`.

These settings are an experimental candidate; adoption is decided in [the comparison report](model_compare_3rcd0n.md). The S2 config is untouched.

Grid edge: p0_v_std. Refinement range end: q_soc, q_v, r, p0_v_std. The search is not extended; the objective may fall beyond an edge.
